messages:
nina_ae: Quick sync for BlueHarbor POC — they want a commit proposal. Requirement: steady 800 RPS text-gen (median 140 tokens), peaks up to 2.5k RPS for ~5-10m, and strong 95th percentile SLAs: <=400ms. They also require customer KMS + per-request audit. Can we size reserved + autoscale?
tariq_ops: For median 140 tokens that ups GPU time per request. Rough calc: with optimized runtime, one rtx-a6000 equiv handles ~60-80 RPS at avg 140 tokens if single-request latency target ~200-300ms. For steady 800 RPS we'd need ~11-14 gpus baseline.
sophia_prod: Agree. Suggest baseline reserved 12 GPUs, plus a burst pool of 8 GPUs for spikes. Use prewarm windows and staged preheat for sessions. Also recommend prefix caching to reduce repeated context costs (saves ~30-50ms common case).
nina_ae: They asked whether bursts will be charged differently and how fast we can scale.
tariq_ops: Autoscale plan: warm-up slot reservations (2 min preheat), add/remove GPUs in 60-120s depending on load. To meet 95th 400ms during sudden 2.5x spikes, we need admission control + queueing with smooth degradation policy. Proposed policy snippet:
```
baseline_reserved: 12
burst_pool_max: 8
preheat_seconds: 120
cooldown_seconds: 180
scale_trigger_rps: 900  # per cluster threshold
latency_slo_95_ms: 400
fallback_variant: small-quant
```
leo_security: On KMS/audit: we support customer-managed keys (AWS/GCP/Azure), HSM-backed rotation, and per-request audit logs. For their compliance we can provide an API for log deletion and show proof of retention policy. Need to confirm DPA and whether they require on-prem data plane.
sophia_prod: Also note: long-running backfills (large token counts) should be routed to batch workers with lower SLOs to avoid polluting tail latency for interactive traffic. We should include that in the proposal runbook.
nina_ae: Pricing ask: they'd like a single line item for "Committed GPUs" and optional "Burst Credits". Can finance give delta numbers?
tariq_ops: Rough pricing guidance: baseline 12 reserved + 8 burst credits. If they want AZ redundancy (good idea), add ~10% extra capacity spread across a secondary AZ (recommend 2 GPUs reserved in a different AZ). Also offer preheat add-on for guaranteed standby warm slots 24/7 (costly but meets instant scaling).
leo_security: One potential blocker: client needs contractual guarantee on key custody and deletion within 48hrs. Legal pre-approval required.
sophia_prod: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/presales-commit-sizing — includes KV warmup checklist, session prefix cache steps, and autoscale templates.
ci-bot: CI Note: Preheat templates updated in infra repo (PR #452).
nina_ae: Action items: 1) I'll send draft commit with 12R+8B + AZ redundancy option (today EOD). 2) Tariq to provide exact autoscale YAML and estimated latency model (tomorrow). 3) Sophia to include runbook excerpts and batch worker routing notes. 4) Leo to prepare KMS + deletion answer and escalate to legal if needed.
tariq_ops: I'll simulate the 2.5k spike in staging with admission control and post perf numbers. Expect results in 24-36h.
leo_security: Will start the security appendix and flag the legal question.
sophia_prod: Adding batch worker routing and prefix cache turn-on steps to the onboarding doc.
nina_ae: Thanks team 44d Will loop back to BlueHarbor after the staging sim and security appendix are ready.
